summary: @or-sdk/data-hub preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs, invoked via `node setup.mjs` in package.json) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js. setup.mjs is control-flow/string-dictionary obfuscated (hex-named identifiers such as `_0x19328d`, proxy-object indirection wrapping standard calls like `execFileSync`). The 727 KB math_init.js is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array dictionary and rotator function, fingerprints of obfuscator.io-style transforms. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: a Node package pulls a second language runtime specifically to execute its own obfuscated code, bypassing Node-based inspection. Nothing about the stated Data Hub SDK purpose requires Bun to run install-time logic, and the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload prevents inspection of what runs under the downloaded runtime. Execution fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
